correctness.rationale: The thirty labelled Fano planes follow from the 168-automorphism orbit; every triple is in six planes and every compatible pair in two. Exactly 105 concurrent and 840 triangular three-line configurations occur, in two and one planes each respectively. Inclusion-exclusion proves the trace vectors and unique-completion excludes four-point supports. Each compatible pair extends to a triangle. The exact, completely constructed mod-two triangle boundary has rank 281 from two separate programs, implying reduced Betti vector with only 559 in degree two. Root positive branch size six bounds Littlestone dimension by three, attained by a shattered triangle.
